title: Search OSS Component
description: Look up an open source component on Sonatype Guide by package URL (purl). Creates or updates the component version entity in Port with the latest intelligence data.

packageUrl.title: Package URL (purl)
packageUrl.description: The full package URL for the component version you want to research. Format: pkg:{ecosystem}/{namespace}/{name}@{version}. Examples: pkg:maven/org.apache.struts/struts2-core@2.5.10, pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20, pkg:pypi/requests@2.31.0

fetchRemediation.title: Fetch Remediation Recommendation
fetchRemediation.description: Also retrieve Sonatype Guide's recommended safe upgrade path for this component.
